description: The implementation reviewer catches a boolean-operator regression that allows invalid todo text.

spec.title: Reject invalid todo text
spec.summary: Keep POST /api/todos limited to non-empty string text values.
spec.problem: Invalid todo text must not be persisted.
goals: Reject missing, empty, and non-string text.

acceptanceCriteria.text: POST /api/todos returns 400 whenever text is missing, empty, or not a string.

spec.approach: Preserve strict input validation in the POST handler.

affectedAreas.change: Validate text before creating a todo.

spec.testPlan: Exercise missing, empty, numeric, and valid string values.

implementationSummary: Strengthened the POST validation condition for todo text.
